major_cooldowns.name: Recklessness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown as your primary damage cooldown; pairs naturally with Avatar via Anger Management and should be stacked with Bloodlust and on-use trinkets.

major_cooldowns.name: Avatar
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use immediately after Recklessness every window; especially critical for Mountain Thane builds where it amplifies Storm Surge and Avatar of the Storm synergies.

major_cooldowns.name: Bladestorm
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Slayer spec only - cast only when Enraged and either Recklessness is active or Recklessness has more than 30 seconds remaining on its cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Odyn's Fury
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast first in the opener before Recklessness and Avatar to trigger Enrage and avoid crowding the burst window; use on cooldown throughout the fight.

rules.description: Stack Avatar with Recklessness every window
rules.action: Always cast Avatar within 5 seconds of Recklessness to stack their damage bonuses - they share cooldown reduction from Anger Management and will stay aligned throughout the fight.

rules.description: Ensure Enrage is active before Bladestorm
rules.action: Always cast Rampage to trigger Enrage before pressing Bladestorm - casting Bladestorm without Enrage wastes its primary damage amplification.
Hold Bladestorm if Recklessness is coming up within 15 seconds so you can cast it inside the burst window for maximum combined damage.

rules.description: Cast Odyn's Fury first in the opener
rules.action: Open with Odyn's Fury before Recklessness and Avatar to trigger Enrage and front-load damage without cluttering the burst window; then immediately follow with Recklessness, Avatar, and trinkets.

rules.description: Maintain Enrage uptime at all times
rules.action: Keep Enrage active continuously by casting Rampage whenever Enrage is about to expire or rage reaches 100 - Enrage amplifies virtually all your damage so letting it fall off is a major DPS loss.

rules.description: Do not delay cooldowns more than 10-15 seconds
rules.action: Use Recklessness, Avatar, Bladestorm, and Odyn's Fury on cooldown; only delay them if holding will grant a full extra usage against incoming adds or an execute phase in the final minute of the fight.

rules.description: Keep Whirlwind cleave buff active on 2+ targets
rules.action: On 2 or more targets, refresh the Whirlwind buff whenever it drops so your single-target abilities cleave to additional targets; prioritize Whirlwind above the normal rotation whenever the buff is missing.

rules.description: Minimize downtime with Charge and Heroic Leap
rules.action: Use Charge and Heroic Leap proactively to stay on target and eliminate gaps in melee contact - rage generation and Enrage uptime depend entirely on hitting enemies, so any time spent out of melee range is a direct DPS loss.
